description: Format-agnostic bytecode mutation plan — 8 primitives operating on raw byte buffer

FIND.description: Search for exact byte sequence in buffer, store named offset reference for later ops

start.desc: Start search at this offset (absolute or {ref}+N)

FIND.failure: skip — dependent ops that reference this output also become no-ops

WRITE.description: Overwrite bytes at offset without changing buffer size

INSERT.description: Insert bytes at offset, shifting everything right
INSERT.failure: skip (e.g., would exceed max buffer size)

DELETE.description: Remove byte range, shifting everything left

offset.desc: Start offset of range to delete

SET_INT.description: Write integer value at offset with specified width and endianness

INC_INT.description: Read integer, add delta, write back. Used for counter/size adjustments.

SIZE_TO.description: Set integer field to the byte-length between two named offset references. The most critical primitive for binary formats — updates length/size fields after mutation.

field_offset.desc: Offset of the integer to update

range_start.desc: Named offset ref for range start

range_end.desc: Named offset ref for range end, or 'END' for buffer end

PRESERVE.description: Protect byte range from AFL++ havoc mutation phase

offset_syntax.end: Special: 'END' refers to the end of the buffer (for SIZE_TO range_end)

fields.transition_id: string — barrier transition this plan targets
fields.desired_outcome: boolean — which branch direction to aim for

mechanism.type: string — brief description of the strategy

fields.steps: array of step objects, each with {op, params: {...}}
fields.scaffold_template: optional hex string — complete valid input as fallback
fields.scaffold_script: optional Python3 script — generate scaffold bytes programmatically
fields.focus_ranges: optional array — byte ranges that control the barrier
fields.preserve_ranges: optional array — byte ranges that must stay intact
